title: Golden Rings Melting Figure
description: A dark humanoid female figure emerges from a black and beige rocky formation, her body covered in numerous golden rings of varying sizes. White liquid cascades down from her chest like a waterfall. Her head is tilted, revealing bright pink glowing eyes and large gold hoop earrings. The background consists of large, out-of-focus colorful bokeh orbs in purple, pink, and yellow against a dark backdrop.
prompt: A surreal dark humanoid female figure rising from a black rocky base, her body textured with flowing black and beige patterns and embedded with many different sized golden rings. White liquid pours from her chest like a waterfall. She has smooth dark skin, striking pink glowing eyes, and large gold hoop earrings. Dramatic colorful bokeh lights in purple, pink, and yellow float in the dark background, cinematic lighting, highly detailed, surreal atmosphere.
